'''Wally Burnside''' is a [[human]] quest giver located on [[Crown Island]] in [[Lapidis Isle]]. A crewman aboard a Kul Tiran vessel, the ''Tidemaster'', he was shipwrecked on Crown Island when is was scuttled in [[Shank's Reef]] on Lapidis Isle after a battle against the [[Southsea Freebooters]].
